Table

1

Data table

<poad-table>

Rows and columns: sorting by click (single or multiple, in the language’s order), pagination, server-side data, row selection with a Shift range, empty and loading states. With a selection, the table becomes a grid whose rows are reachable from the keyboard.

Angularrendered by @poadio/ui-angularNext.jsrendered by @poadio/ui-reactReactrendered by @poadio/ui-reactVuerendered by @poadio/ui-vueVanillarendered by @poadio/ui-elements

Columns as <poad-column> (poadCellTemplate templates) or as data through [colonnes]. The ui-angular table already carries later slices (frozen columns, editing…): they will be documented here once they are on all four renderers.

import { Component, computed, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { PoadCellTemplateDirective, PoadColumnComponent, PoadTableComponent } from '@poadio/ui-angular';

interface Project { id: number; name: string; env: string; pods: number }

@Component({
  selector: 'app-table-demo',
  imports: [PoadTableComponent, PoadColumnComponent, PoadCellTemplateDirective],
  template: `
    <div class="demo-wide">
      <poad-table [value]="projects" dataKey="id" title="Projects" selectionMode="multiple" [(selection)]="selection"
        paginator [rows]="5" [rowsPerPageOptions]="[5, 10]">
        <poad-column field="name" header="Name" sortable>
          <ng-template poadCellTemplate let-row><strong>{{ row.name }}</strong></ng-template>
        </poad-column>
        <poad-column field="env" header="Env" />
        <poad-column field="pods" header="Pods" dataType="number" sortable />
      </poad-table>
    </div>
    <code>selected={{ ids() }}</code>
  `,
})
export default class TableDemo {
  readonly projects: Project[] = [
    { id: 1, name: 'gestion', env: 'recette', pods: 4 }, { id: 2, name: 'inventaire', env: 'neo', pods: 0 },
    { id: 3, name: 'demo2', env: 'neo', pods: 2 }, { id: 4, name: 'best', env: 'recette', pods: 12 },
    { id: 5, name: 'demo10', env: 'recette', pods: 1 }, { id: 6, name: 'atlas', env: 'neo', pods: 7 },
    { id: 7, name: 'zephyr', env: 'neo', pods: 3 }, { id: 8, name: 'cartographie', env: 'recette', pods: 5 },
  ];
  readonly selection = signal<Project | Project[] | null>([]);
  readonly ids = computed(() => ((this.selection() ?? []) as Project[]).map((p) => p.id).join(',') || 'none');
}

Next.js uses the same package as React: the demo is rendered by @poadio/ui-react. The code shows the App Router integration — a client component ('use client') for state, rendered by a server page.

// app/table-demo.tsx — client component (state, handlers)
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { PoadTable, type PoadTableColumn } from '@poadio/ui-react';

interface Project { id: number; name: string; env: string; pods: number }
const projects: Project[] = [
  { id: 1, name: 'gestion', env: 'recette', pods: 4 }, { id: 2, name: 'inventaire', env: 'neo', pods: 0 },
  { id: 3, name: 'demo2', env: 'neo', pods: 2 }, { id: 4, name: 'best', env: 'recette', pods: 12 },
  { id: 5, name: 'demo10', env: 'recette', pods: 1 }, { id: 6, name: 'atlas', env: 'neo', pods: 7 },
  { id: 7, name: 'zephyr', env: 'neo', pods: 3 }, { id: 8, name: 'cartographie', env: 'recette', pods: 5 },
];
const columns: PoadTableColumn<Project>[] = [
  { field: 'name', header: 'Name', sortable: true, cell: ({ row }) => <strong>{row.name}</strong> },
  { field: 'env', header: 'Env' },
  { field: 'pods', header: 'Pods', dataType: 'number', sortable: true },
];

export default function TableDemo() {
  const [selection, setSelection] = useState<Project[]>([]);
  return (
    <>
      <div className="demo-wide">
        <PoadTable value={projects} columns={columns} dataKey="id" title="Projects" selectionMode="multiple" selection={selection}
          onSelectionChange={(s) => setSelection(s as Project[])} paginator defaultRows={5} rowsPerPageOptions={[5, 10]} />
      </div>
      <code>selected={selection.map((p) => p.id).join(',') || 'none'}</code>
    </>
  );
}

// app/page.tsx — server component: HTML rendered on the server, hydrated on the client
import TableDemo from './table-demo';

export default function Page() {
  return <TableDemo />;
}

Columns as data (:columns) and / or <PoadColumn> in the slot (its default slot is the cell). For 10,000 rows, pass the array through shallowRef.

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { PoadColumn, PoadTable } from '@poadio/ui-vue';

interface Project { id: number; name: string; env: string; pods: number }
const projects: Project[] = [
  { id: 1, name: 'gestion', env: 'recette', pods: 4 }, { id: 2, name: 'inventaire', env: 'neo', pods: 0 },
  { id: 3, name: 'demo2', env: 'neo', pods: 2 }, { id: 4, name: 'best', env: 'recette', pods: 12 },
  { id: 5, name: 'demo10', env: 'recette', pods: 1 }, { id: 6, name: 'atlas', env: 'neo', pods: 7 },
  { id: 7, name: 'zephyr', env: 'neo', pods: 3 }, { id: 8, name: 'cartographie', env: 'recette', pods: 5 },
];
const selection = ref<Project[]>([]);
</script>

<template>
  <div class="demo-wide">
    <PoadTable v-model:selection="selection" :value="projects" data-key="id" title="Projects" selection-mode="multiple"
      paginator :rows="5" :rows-per-page-options="[5, 10]">

heading and body-max-height replace title and scroll-height (properties of every DOM element). selectionchange is also a native text-selection event: read event.detail.

<script type="module">import '@poadio/ui-elements/define';</script>

<div class="demo-wide">
  <poad-table id="projects" data-key="id" heading="Projects" selection-mode="multiple" paginator rows="5" rows-per-page-options="[5, 10]"
    columns='[{"field":"name","header":"Name","sortable":true},{"field":"env","header":"Env"},{"field":"pods","header":"Pods","dataType":"number","sortable":true}]'></poad-table>
</div>
<code id="table-out">selected=none</code>

<script type="module">
  const table = document.querySelector('#projects');
  table.value = [
    { id: 1, name: 'gestion', env: 'recette', pods: 4 }, { id: 2, name: 'inventaire', env: 'neo', pods: 0 },
    { id: 3, name: 'demo2', env: 'neo', pods: 2 }, { id: 4, name: 'best', env: 'recette', pods: 12 },
    { id: 5, name: 'demo10', env: 'recette', pods: 1 }, { id: 6, name: 'atlas', env: 'neo', pods: 7 },
    { id: 7, name: 'zephyr', env: 'neo', pods: 3 }, { id: 8, name: 'cartographie', env: 'recette', pods: 5 },
  ];
  table.renderCell = ({ row, column }) => (column.field === 'name' ? Object.assign(document.createElement('strong'), { textContent: row.name }) : undefined);
  table.addEventListener('selectionchange', (e) => {
    document.querySelector('#table-out').textContent = `selected=${e.detail.map((p) => p.id).join(',') || 'none'}`;
  });
</script>

What it is for

To compare records of the same shape (projects, deployments, users). This page covers columns, sorting, pages and selection; filters (global search, filter row, count footer), the side panel, the filter chip, the row detail, row groups, the tree table, row actions, frozen columns, the responsive table, virtual scrolling, row reordering, editing, CSV export, column width, the column menu, column order, the group zone, the column chooser, row numbers, grouped headers and density, and the row edit dialog have their own pages. For a list of cards, a plain v-for / map.

Keyboard

KeyEffect
Enter SpaceOn a header: sorts; on a row (grid): picks it (toggles with multiple).
↓ ↑Next / previous row; with Shift, extends the selection from the anchor.
Home EndFirst / last row of the page.
Page Down Page UpTen rows down / up.
Ctrl + ASelects all (multiple).

Accessibility

  • Without selection: a native <table> (scope="col" headers). With selection: role="grid" (aria-multiselectable with multiple), aria-selected on rows, a single row in the tab order.
  • aria-sort on the first sorted column (none on the other sortable ones); sort buttons named “Sort by …”.
  • aria-rowcount (rows + header) and aria-rowindex accounting for the page; aria-busy while loading; selection bar in aria-live.

Stylesheets to import

Nothing to import for this component: it bundles its own sheet (@poadio/ui-core/table.css, @poadio/ui-core/paginator.css, @poadio/ui-core/checkbox.css, @poadio/ui-core/select.css, @poadio/ui-core/option-list.css, @poadio/ui-core/floating.css) at build time. How to change

In the application’s global stylesheet, after the @poadio/ui-core sheets: on :root for the whole application, or on a container for one area only. A floating layer (menu, list, dialog) may be rendered outside its container: for it, prefer :root.

src/styles.css
/* The whole application */
:root {
  --poad-accent: #0b7a5c;        /* Accent colour: primary button, checked box, selection */
  --poad-radius: 4px;            /* Corner rounding of controls */
}

/* In dark theme only */
.theme-dark {
  --poad-accent: #3fcf9f;        /* Accent colour: primary button, checked box, selection */
}

/* One area only */
.checkout {
  --poad-radius: 0;              /* Corner rounding of controls */
}

import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { PoadButtonComponent, PoadColumnComponent, PoadIconComponent, PoadRowActionsDirective, PoadTableComponent } from '@poadio/ui-angular';

interface Project { id: number; name: string; env: string; pods: number }

@Component({
  selector: 'app-table-row-actions-demo',
  imports: [PoadTableComponent, PoadColumnComponent, PoadRowActionsDirective, PoadButtonComponent, PoadIconComponent],
  template: `
    <div class="demo-wide">
      <poad-table [value]="projects()" dataKey="id" title="Projects" selectionMode="multiple" rowActionsWidth="84px">
        <poad-column field="name" header="Name" />
        <poad-column field="env" header="Env" />
        <poad-column field="pods" header="Pods" dataType="number" />
        <ng-template poadRowActions let-row>
          <button poadButton severity="ghost" variant="text" size="sm" icon [attr.aria-label]="'Edit ' + row.name" (click)="last.set('edit ' + row.name)"><poad-icon name="edit" [size]="14" /></button>
          <button poadButton severity="ghost" variant="text" size="sm" icon [attr.aria-label]="'Delete ' + row.name" (click)="remove(row)"><poad-icon name="trash" [size]="14" /></button>
        </ng-template>
      </poad-table>
    </div>
    <code>last={{ last() }} · rows={{ projects().length }}</code>
  `,
})
export default class TableRowActionsDemo {
  readonly projects = signal<Project[]>([
    { id: 1, name: 'gestion', env: 'recette', pods: 4 }, { id: 2, name: 'inventaire', env: 'neo', pods: 0 },
    { id: 3, name: 'demo2', env: 'neo', pods: 2 }, { id: 4, name: 'best', env: 'recette', pods: 12 },
  ]);
  readonly last = signal('none');
  remove(p: Project): void { this.projects.update((l) => l.filter((x) => x.id !== p.id)); this.last.set('delete ' + p.name); }
}

Next.js uses the same package as React: the demo is rendered by @poadio/ui-react. The code shows the App Router integration — a client component ('use client') for state, rendered by a server page.

// app/table-row-actions-demo.tsx — client component (state, handlers)
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { PoadButton, PoadIcon, PoadTable, type PoadTableColumn } from '@poadio/ui-react';

interface Project { id: number; name: string; env: string; pods: number }
const initial: Project[] = [
  { id: 1, name: 'gestion', env: 'recette', pods: 4 }, { id: 2, name: 'inventaire', env: 'neo', pods: 0 },
  { id: 3, name: 'demo2', env: 'neo', pods: 2 }, { id: 4, name: 'best', env: 'recette', pods: 12 },
];
const columns: PoadTableColumn<Project>[] = [
  { field: 'name', header: 'Name' }, { field: 'env', header: 'Env' }, { field: 'pods', header: 'Pods', dataType: 'number' },
];

export default function TableRowActionsDemo() {
  const [projects, setProjects] = useState(initial);
  const [last, setLast] = useState('none');
  return (
    <>
      <div className="demo-wide">
        <PoadTable value={projects} columns={columns} dataKey="id" title="Projects" selectionMode="multiple" rowActionsWidth="84px"
          rowActions={({ row }) => (
            <>
              <PoadButton severity="ghost" variant="text" size="sm" icon aria-label={`Edit ${row.name}`} onClick={() => setLast(`edit ${row.name}`)}><PoadIcon name="edit" size={14} /></PoadButton>
              <PoadButton severity="ghost" variant="text" size="sm" icon aria-label={`Delete ${row.name}`}
                onClick={() => { setProjects((p) => p.filter((x) => x.id !== row.id)); setLast(`delete ${row.name}`); }}><PoadIcon name="trash" size={14} /></PoadButton>
            </>
          )} />
      </div>
      <code>last={last} · rows={projects.length}</code>
    </>
  );
}

// app/page.tsx — server component: HTML rendered on the server, hydrated on the client
import TableRowActionsDemo from './table-row-actions-demo';

export default function Page() {
  return <TableRowActionsDemo />;
}

<script type="module">
  const table = document.querySelector('#with-actions');
  table.value = [
    { id: 1, name: 'gestion', env: 'recette', pods: 4 }, { id: 2, name: 'inventaire', env: 'neo', pods: 0 },
    { id: 3, name: 'demo2', env: 'neo', pods: 2 }, { id: 4, name: 'best', env: 'recette', pods: 12 },
  ];
  const show = (last) => { document.querySelector('#actions-out').textContent = `last=${last} · rows=${table.value.length}`; };
  const action = (label, iconName, onClick) => {
    const b = document.createElement('poad-button');
    Object.assign(b, { severity: 'ghost', variant: 'text', size: 'sm', icon: true, ariaLabel: label });
    b.append(Object.assign(document.createElement('poad-icon'), { name: iconName, size: 14 }));
    b.addEventListener('click', onClick);
    return b;
  };
  table.renderRowActions = ({ row }) => [
    action(`Edit ${row.name}`, 'edit', () => show(`edit ${row.name}`)),
    action(`Delete ${row.name}`, 'trash', () => { table.value = table.value.filter((x) => x.id !== row.id); show(`delete ${row.name}`); }),
  ];
</script>

What it is for

To act on a row without selecting it first. Actions are an application template (named icon buttons, a menu); a click or Enter on them does not select the row. rowActionsWidth sets the column width, rowActionsAlwaysVisible shows them all the time (touch screens, primary actions). On a table that scrolls horizontally, the column stays frozen on the right (stickyActions, see frozen columns). To act on several rows, the selection bar.

Properties

Below, the <poad-table> properties specific to this feature; all the others are described in Data table.

string'120px'Width of the row actions column (poadRowActions).
booleanfalseRow actions always visible (otherwise on row hover or focus).
string—Path of a row's key (otherwise: the row itself).

Keyboard

KeyEffect
TabReaches the row’s actions, in the natural tab order (they appear when focus enters the row).
Enter SpaceOn an action: triggers it, without selecting the row.

Accessibility

  • The column header has a hidden label (“Actions”, catalog); each icon button must be named by the application (aria-label, for example “Edit gestion”).
  • Hidden by opacity only: actions stay in the accessibility tree and the tab order, and become visible on focus.

Nothing to import for this component: it bundles its own sheet (@poadio/ui-core/table.css, @poadio/ui-core/button.css, @poadio/ui-core/icon.css) at build time. Only tokens.css and base.css are loaded once, globally (see Installation).

<script type="module">
  const table = document.querySelector('#expandable');
  table.value = [
    { id: 1, name: 'gestion', env: 'recette', pods: 4, owner: 'Hélène' }, { id: 2, name: 'inventaire', env: 'neo', pods: 0, owner: 'Zoé' },
    { id: 3, name: 'demo2', env: 'neo', pods: 2, owner: 'Noël' }, { id: 4, name: 'best', env: 'recette', pods: 12, owner: 'Hélène' },
  ];
  table.rowExpandable = (p) => p.pods > 0;
  table.renderExpansion = ({ row }) => Object.assign(document.createElement('div'), { className: 'detail', textContent: `Owner: ${row.owner} · ${row.pods} pods running on ${row.env}` });
  const show = () => { document.querySelector('#expansion-out').textContent = `expanded=${table.expandedRowKeys.join(',') || 'none'}`; };
  table.addEventListener('rowexpand', show);
  table.addEventListener('rowcollapse', show);
</script>

What it is for

To show what does not fit in the columns (log, description, sub-list) without leaving the table. Expandable rows are chosen (rowExpandable, boolean or a function of the row); expandMode="single" keeps only one open. Expanded keys (expandedRowKeys, by dataKey) can be held by the application. For nested rows of the same shape, see the tree table.

Properties

Below, the <poad-table> properties specific to this feature; all the others are described in Data table.

NameTypeDefaultDescription
boolean | ((row: T) => boolean)trueExpandable rows (detail row): boolean, or (row) → boolean.
[(expandedRowKeys)]unknown[]—Keys of the rows whose detail is expanded; two-way.
'single' | 'multiple''multiple'single: one detail row expanded at a time; multiple: several.
string—Path of a row's key (otherwise: the row itself).

'single' | 'multiple'—single: one detail row expanded at a time; multiple: several.
string—Path of a row's key (otherwise: the row itself).

Keyboard

KeyEffect
TabReaches a row’s expand button (one button per expandable row).
Enter SpaceOn the button: expands or collapses the detail (without selecting the row).

Accessibility

  • The button carries aria-expanded and is named “Expand” / “Collapse” by the catalog; its column header has a hidden label (“Detail”).
  • The detail row follows its row across the full width; it does not count in aria-rowcount and does not shift the grid’s aria-rowindex.
Stylesheets, theme tokens and texts stylesheets to import, 34 tokens, catalogue texts

Stylesheets to import

Nothing to import for this component: it bundles its own sheet (@poadio/ui-core/table.css, @poadio/ui-core/icon.css) at build time. Only tokens.css and base.css are loaded once, globally (see Installation).

How to change

In the application’s global stylesheet, after the @poadio/ui-core sheets: on :root for the whole application, or on a container for one area only. A floating layer (menu, list, dialog) may be rendered outside its container: for it, prefer :root.

src/styles.css
/* The whole application */
:root {
  --poad-accent: #0b7a5c;        /* Accent colour: primary button, checked box, selection */
  --poad-radius: 4px;            /* Corner rounding of controls */
}

/* In dark theme only */
.theme-dark {
  --poad-accent: #3fcf9f;        /* Accent colour: primary button, checked box, selection */
}

/* One area only */
.checkout {
  --poad-radius: 0;              /* Corner rounding of controls */
}

import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-table-export-demo',

  template: `
    <poad-table [value]="services" dataKey="id" title="Services" showExport exportFilename="services" paginator [rows]="3" (csvExport)="exported($event)">
      <poad-column field="name" header="Service" sortable />
      <poad-column field="env" header="Env" sortable />
      <poad-column field="pods" header="Pods" dataType="number" sortable />
      <poad-column field="active" header="Active" dataType="boolean" />
      <poad-column field="token" header="Token" [exportable]="false" />

    <code>{{ last() }}</code>
  `,
})
export default class TableExportDemo {
  readonly services: Service[] = [
    { id: 1, name: 'web-01', env: 'prod', pods: 4, active: true, token: '••••' },
    { id: 2, name: 'web-02', env: 'prod', pods: 4, active: true, token: '••••' },
    { id: 3, name: 'api', env: 'neo', pods: 2.5, active: true, token: '••••' },
    { id: 4, name: 'worker', env: 'recette', pods: 1, active: false, token: '••••' },
    { id: 5, name: '=cron', env: 'recette', pods: 1, active: true, token: '••••' },
  ];
  readonly last = signal('—');
  /** Avant le téléchargement : le contenu du fichier (`preventDefault()` le garderait pour vous). */
  exported(e: PoadCsvExportEvent): void {
    this.last.set(`${e.filename} · ${e.rows} · ${e.csv.replace('﻿', '').split('\r\n')[0]}`);
  }
}

You are already on a small screen: the demo above behaves as it would on a phone. To see it alone, full screen:

Open the demo full screen

What it is for

To take the displayed data away (report, check in a spreadsheet). showExport adds the “Export CSV” button to the toolbar; the exportCSV() method does the same export from your own button, with options: selectionOnly (only the chosen rows), allColumns (hidden columns too), filename, separator, bom. The file follows the screen: non-hidden columns in display order (a column with exportable: false, or without a field, is never in it), rows after filter and sort, every page. It also follows the language: ; and the decimal comma in French (1234,5), , and the point in English, YYYY-MM-DD dates, Yes / No booleans from the catalogue, UTF-8 BOM so that Excel reads accents. A text starting with =, +, - or @ gets an apostrophe in front: a spreadsheet does not run a formula coming from the data. Before the download, the csvExport event gives the content; preventDefault() keeps it for you (sending to a server, preview). No native Excel (.xlsx): CSV opens in every spreadsheet without a third-party library. With server data (lazy), the table only knows the page it received: export on the server.

Accessibility

  • The button is a real <button> named by its text, taken from the catalogue (table.exportCsv), with a decorative icon.
  • The file repeats the column headers: what is read on screen is what is written in the file.
Stylesheets, theme tokens and texts stylesheets to import, 34 tokens, catalogue texts

Stylesheets to import

Nothing to import for this component: it bundles its own sheet (@poadio/ui-core/table.css, @poadio/ui-core/icon.css) at build time. Only tokens.css and base.css are loaded once, globally (see Installation).

// app/layout.tsx
import '@poadio/ui-core/tokens.css';          // once, in the global stylesheet
import '@poadio/ui-core/base.css';            // once, in the global stylesheet
import '@poadio/ui-core/table.css';           // this component
import '@poadio/ui-core/icon.css';            // this component
// main.tsx
import '@poadio/ui-core/tokens.css';          // once, in the global stylesheet
import '@poadio/ui-core/base.css';            // once, in the global stylesheet
import '@poadio/ui-core/table.css';           // this component
import '@poadio/ui-core/icon.css';            // this component
// main.ts
import '@poadio/ui-core/tokens.css';          // once, in the global stylesheet

import '@poadio/ui-core/icon.css';            // this component

How to change

In the application’s global stylesheet, after the @poadio/ui-core sheets: on :root for the whole application, or on a container for one area only. A floating layer (menu, list, dialog) may be rendered outside its container: for it, prefer :root.

src/styles.css
/* The whole application */
:root {
  --poad-accent: #0b7a5c;        /* Accent colour: primary button, checked box, selection */
  --poad-radius: 4px;            /* Corner rounding of controls */
}

/* In dark theme only */
.theme-dark {
  --poad-accent: #3fcf9f;        /* Accent colour: primary button, checked box, selection */
}

/* One area only */
.checkout {
  --poad-radius: 0;              /* Corner rounding of controls */
}
